name: Mogadishu Cathedral (ruins)
subtitle: An Italian colonial-era cathedral completed in 1928, now a roofless ruin.

facts.label: Ruin
facts.value: Broken walls and roofless nave symbolise civil-war devastation

facts.label: Future
facts.value: Debate on reuse; local perspectives needed

parts.text: An Italian colonial-era cathedral completed in 1928, now a roofless ruin. Its future is debated by Somalis; handle with care as a colonial-era and war-damaged site.
